title: A Taylor–Wiles prime at a time: the deformed trace at one auxiliary place clears the denominator
summary: At one auxiliary (Taylor–Wiles) place w_j with q_j ≡ 1 mod ℓ^ν, the stabiliser of a line in GL_n(k_{w_j}) carries a character to ℤ/ℓ^ν whose transfer factors through the determinant; an abstract first-order lemma about weighted sums over a finite group then produces an operator F at w_j that ties the trace of tame inertia to that of Frobenius on forms, modulo ℓ^ν (`exists_tie`). Taking one such tie at each auxiliary place, the top coefficient of Ribet's element (a polynomial in one variable per place) clears the denominator of the projection to the eigensystems 𝓧 up to the factor d·c (`exists_diagOp_mem_ellIntegralForms`).

imports.lean: abbrev FinPlace (E : Type*) [Field E] := HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 E)

imports.name: FinPlace.q

imports.name: card_ResField
imports.lean:
lemma card_ResField : .card (ResField w) = w.q := card_congr
    (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective (algebraMap_ResField_surjective w)).1 ▸ by rcongr; simp
imports.text: The residue field k_w has exactly q_w elements.

imports.name: Kw
imports.lean: abbrev Kw : Subgroup (GL n (LocField w)) := intGL n (LocInt w).1

imports.name: reduceGL
imports.lean: def reduceGL := intGL.map (n := n) (O := v.integer) (S := ResField w) (residue (LocInt w))

imports.name: reduceGL_surjective
imports.lean:
lemma reduceGL_surjective : Surjective (reduceGL (n := n) (w := w)) :=
  (GL_map_surjective (residue (LocInt _)) residue_surjective).comp (⟨⟨_, ·, rfl⟩, rfl⟩)
imports.text: The reduction homomorphism GL_n(O_w) → GL_n(k_w) is surjective.

imports.name: residueOrZero
imports.lean: def residueOrZero (x : LocField w) : ResField w := if h : v x ≤ 1 then residue _ ⟨x, h⟩ else 0
imports.text: For x ∈ E_w: the residue of x in k_w if x is integral (v(x) ≤ 1), and 0 otherwise.

imports.name: diagGL

def diagGL : (n → Rˣ) →* GL n R :=

imports.text: For a ring R, the homomorphism (n → R^×) → GL_n(R) sending a family of units to the diagonal matrix with these entries.
